findings.evidence: FiniteDimensional.lean:297 `noncomputable def indFDRep {k : Type u} {G : Type v} ... : FDRep k G := (indSmallModel A).object`; indSmallModel (line 284-294) builds `FDRep.of ρ` on `Shrink.{u} V`. Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/FDRep.lean:64 `abbrev FDRep (R : Type u) (G : Type v) [Ring R] [Monoid G] := Action (FGModuleCat.{u} R) G` — carriers in `Type u`, `G` in any universe. The PR itself deletes the identically-worded note in Artin.lean.
findings.fix: Rewrite the note to describe the post-PR situation (`indFDRep` already produces a carrier in the universe of the field, via the small model), and either generalize `variable (F : Type) [Field F] [Fintype F]` at line 221 to `Type*` or state plainly that the remaining restriction is a deferred choice, not a limitation of the induction API.
findings.issue: The implementation note asserts that "the induced representation `(ℂ[G] ⊗[ℂ] A)_B` built by `TauCeti.indFDRep` lives in the universe of `G`", concludes that induction "needs `GL (Fin 2) F` — hence `F` — in the universe of `ℂ`", and says lifting back down "would be a genuine addition to the induction API". After this PR all three are false: `indFDRep {k : Type u} {G : Type v}` returns an object of `FDRep k G`, whose carrier is in `Type u` by construction (`indSmallModel` shrinks along `Shrink.linearEquiv`), so `F : Type` at line 221 is no longer forced. This is the same stale note the PR deletes from Artin.lean:57-61.

summary: The small-carrier `indFDRep` is a faithful conjugation of `Rep.ind` along `Shrink.linearEquiv`, with a constructed equivariant witness, and every universe split is a genuine generalization consistent with `Rep.indCoindIso`. But the PR removes the stale universe note in Artin.lean while leaving the same, now-false claim about `indFDRep` in PrincipalSeries.lean.
